objective: Measure how temperature and independently applied NV-frame strain modes change the optimum, near-optimal connected regions, and persistence of the canonical 200 kHz XY8 EDT landscape.

preregistration.replacement_rule: Any change to scan axes, physical assumptions, carrier policies, topology thresholds, or refinement rules requires a new configuration_id and freeze record.
preregistration.source_data_replacement_rule: Author-supplied data may replace digitized data only through a new frozen literature bundle and a new scan configuration version.

magnetic_bias.provenance: Explicitly frozen repository-model assumption inherited from DEFAULT_MODEL_KWARGS; not a measured device calibration.

transition.name: m_s_0_like_to_m_s_minus_1_like
transition.selection_rule: Track the lower-frequency transition from the state continuously connected to m_s=0 to the state continuously connected to m_s=-1 at the reference field.
transition.tracking_method: maximum eigenvector overlap with continuity across adjacent environmental grid points

signal_and_control.tau_convention: tau is half the centre-to-centre pulse spacing
signal_and_control.depth_convention: N counts complete XY8 blocks and the total pi-pulse count is 8N
signal_and_control.sequence_duration_convention: T_sequence = 16*N*tau before preparation and readout overhead

environmental_detuning_integration.method: At every (tau,N), multiply the canonical scalar control gain by the coherent finite-pulse response ratio G(detuning)/G(reference detuning=0).
environmental_detuning_integration.normalization: The response ratio is normalized independently at each (tau,N), so the reference environment exactly retains the canonical scalar model.
environmental_detuning_integration.double_counting_guard: The coherent calculation supplies only the relative environmental detuning penalty; the nominal independent pulse-fidelity term remains the canonical baseline resource model.

carrier_policies.description: Hold the microwave carrier at the transition frequency calculated at 300 K and zero strain.
Set the microwave carrier equal to the calculated transition frequency at every environmental condition.
carrier_policies.interpretation_limit: This is an ideal recalibration benchmark and does not include calibration time, estimation error, or drift during a sequence.

operational.source_validity: Inside the reported ranges of the frozen D(T), experimental T1(T), and digitized first-principles T1(T) inputs.

extended_stress_test.source_validity: Restricted to the common 100-400 K range so the digitized Mondal curve is never extrapolated.

strain_axes.amplitude_status: predeclared engineering sensitivity range, not an experimentally measured strain distribution
strain_axes.coordinate_frame: NV frame used by the frozen Udvarhelyi spin-strain Hamiltonian

paths.scan_rule: Evaluate once per temperature; do not duplicate over amplitude.

paths.description: Pure epsilon_zz in the NV frame.

strain_axes.combination_policy: Version 1 varies one strain path at a time. Combined strain tensors are excluded until the one-path maps and transition tracking pass validation.
strain_axes.extended_range_policy: A later plus-or-minus 500 microstrain stress test requires a new configuration version.

relaxation_policy.effective_coherence_rule: 1/T2_eff(T) = 1/Tphi + 1/(2*T1(T)), with 1/Tphi chosen once so T2_eff(300 K)=300 us.
relaxation_policy.double_counting_guard: Do not multiply the nominal coherence envelope by a second full T1 decay. Compare the two T1 sources as separate variants and never combine or fit them.

confirmation_timing_grid.role: confirm only cells selected by the frozen refinement rules

topology_analysis.region_tracking_rule: Track components between adjacent environmental cells by maximum overlap of their (tau,N) masks; do not equate local integer labels across cells.
refinement_selection_rules: reference environment for both carrier policies
every cell whose discovery optimum touches a tau or N sweep boundary
every cell where beta_0 differs from any immediately adjacent environmental cell
every cell where the recommended N category changes relative to an immediately adjacent environmental cell
the first cell on each side of every detected category or beta_0 transition
stable_result_requirements: global optimum agrees between discovery and confirmation grids
beta_0 agrees under four- and eight-neighbour connectivity or disagreement is reported
the primary region contains multiple timing and depth samples
the primary region does not touch a sweep boundary
timing width is stable under the existing medium-to-fine refinement tolerance

interpretation_limits: The strain amplitudes are controlled sensitivity coordinates, not a measured strain distribution for a particular diamond.
The ideal retracked-carrier policy omits calibration cost and residual estimation error.
Temperature-dependent optical contrast, photon rate, overhead, pulse fidelity, and non-T1 bath dynamics remain fixed in version 1.
A stable sampled-grid beta_0 is evidence about the numerical EDT landscape, not proof of continuum topology.
No environment-conditioned result may be described as experimental validation.
